title: Plus Size Gathered Sea-island Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This is the kind of dress you reach for when you want something flattering but not restrictive. The higher waistline helps shape the body, and the flowy skirt moves easily without hugging the stomach area. The flutter sleeves soften the look and add a bit of coverage, so it works really well for wedding guests, family events, or dressy occasions where comfort matters just as much as style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sea-island filament fabircs.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
